# QuickCabRender

> QuickCabRender is a web-based AI rendering tool for cabinetmakers, joiners, kitchen designers and interior designers. Take a screenshot of the 3D view from any CAD program (Mozaik, Cabinet Vision, Microvellum, SketchUp, 2020 Design, Fusion 360, PolyBoard) or a hand sketch, drag it into the browser, and get a photorealistic render in about 40 seconds. No plugin, install or 3D file export needed.

Key facts:
- Built to stay faithful to the drawing: cabinet runs, doors, drawers, windows and openings stay where they were drawn.
- Exact Material Matching: paste a manufacturer's swatch or handle image to apply that exact board, paint, stone or hardware.
- 4K upscaling, an edit tool (change, add or remove an item), and saved settings templates.
- Pricing (USD): 7-day free trial; Starter $19/month (50 credits); Business $49/month (200 credits, 4K, swatch matching, 2 seats); Pro $199/month (1,000 credits, 5 seats). Top-ups: 15 credits $25, 100 credits $90. 1 credit = 1 render. Failed renders are not charged.
- REST API and white-label iFrame embed for suppliers and software companies (from $49/month).
- MCP server for AI assistants: https://api.quickcabrender.com/api/mcp
- Contact: hello@quickcabrender.com
- Founded 2026 in Australia by Thomas Yencken (Joinery Tech Pty Ltd).
- Social: Instagram https://www.instagram.com/quickcabrender/ · YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@QuickCabRender · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/quickcabrender/ · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61587034702401
